release_notes.en-US: Check This Link is now Link Hound. The new black-Labrador-and-link icon appears in the Firefox toolbar and popup, while all existing local scan controls and custom link rules remain the same. The permanent add-on identity, local-only analysis, permissions, and no-data-collection policy are unchanged.

version.approval_notes:
Version 0.3.0 is a branding update: Check This Link is renamed Link Hound. The permanent Gecko add-on ID remains check-this-link@example.com and the existing AMO listing URL remains unchanged, so this is an update to the current listed add-on rather than a new submission.

The changed assets are six local PNG files under extension/icons/: one 1254px Link Hound logo source and five PNG rasterizations at the manifest-declared 16, 32, 48, 96, and 128 pixel sizes. The mark shows a black Labrador with a gold chain-link magnifying glass on a dark background. The artwork is included in the submitted package; there is no remotely hosted image or code. The popup displays the 48px local icon, and manifest action/icon declarations use the same local raster files.

Runtime changes are limited to user-visible strings: Link Hound replaces the old name in the popup title, toolbar tooltip, injected warning badge, and warning tooltip. Detection logic, content-script scope, host permissions, storage permission, local-only processing, data practices, telemetry behavior, and network behavior are unchanged. Declared data collection remains none. The repository test suite, Mozilla lint, and unsigned package build are run before submission.
